purpose: Define backend selection for q-family commands through explicit logical aliases and compatible backend bindings, never by ad hoc provider inference from UI, payload or response content.

topics.name: q Backend Selection
topics.purpose: Define backend selection for q-family commands through explicit logical aliases and compatible backend bindings, never by ad hoc provider inference from UI, payload or response content.

semantics.selection_rule: Each q-family invocation resolves an explicit configured backend alias.
semantics.alias_rule: Logical alias is stable caller-facing backend identity.
semantics.binding_rule: Alias may map to concrete providers/models such as dummyLLM, doubleword or nvidia according to configuration.
semantics.fallback_rule: Fallback is explicit policy; silent provider substitution is forbidden.
semantics.queue_rule: Resolved alias determines q-family queue identity.
semantics.ui_rule: q Editor configures aliases/bindings but does not become backend authority.
semantics.response_rule: Backend response cannot select a new backend/root/command unless an explicit bounded owning operation permits it.

invariants.rule: q-family roles, backend aliases, targets, command namespaces and help metadata remain explicit and do not derive authority from model/backend output.

hard_gates.condition: UI display name used as backend semantic identity
queue keyed by transient provider endpoint instead of alias
